title: RC-001 environment evidence
description: Records the provisioned test environment, especially branch protection, captured by an ADMIN/provisioning step — NOT by the candidate App (which is not granted Administration, not even read). This documents the external condition that makes merge-without-approval unreachable, without polluting the profile under test.

recorded_by.description: identity that recorded this (admin PAT / repo owner) — deliberately NOT the candidate App

installed_on.description: must be the target repo only

granted_permissions.description: must match permissions.json -> candidate; MUST NOT include Administration
